headline: Protest Organizer Issues 400-Page ‘Vibe Manual’ Detailing Required Facial Expressions for Upcoming Demonstration
body:
Ahead of Wednesday’s planned demonstration, the chief coordinator has released a comprehensive, 400-page 'National Sentiment Handbook' that mandates specific emotional states for all participants. The manual, which covers everything from acceptable tear-duct moisture levels during patriotic songs to the exact degree of forehead furrowing required during sloganeering, was drafted to ensure that all ideological differences are successfully sublimated into a single, uniform expression of concern.

“We aren’t just marching; we are curating a mood,” explained the coordinator’s spokesperson, who spent the last three weeks consulting with color theorists and professional mime instructors to finalize the document. “If one person shows up with a cynical smirk or a ‘confused’ look while everyone else is maintaining a ‘stoic-yet-hopeful’ jawline, the entire visual narrative of the protest risks being compromised by a lack of stylistic cohesion.”

Participants are required to submit a ‘Baseline Emotion Scan’ at the protest entrance, where organizers will use a high-resolution camera to ensure no one is projecting unauthorized levels of apathy. Those found lacking in the ‘Rising Above’ category will be diverted to a side lane where they must hold a static pose for forty minutes while listening to a loop of inspirational background music until their expression matches the event’s approved aesthetic.

For those worried about the technicalities, the manual includes a pull-out guide on how to hold a flag with 'ideal ideological neutrality,' suggesting that arms should be kept at a perfect 45-degree angle to avoid suggesting any specific political leanings. “Unity is not an accident,” the spokesperson added. “It is a carefully choreographed sequence of muscles and postures that we have spent thousands of man-hours perfecting for the public good.”
caption: Forget policy—it’s all about the posture. We got a sneak peek at the 'Vibe Manual' for Wednesday’s protest, and let’s just say your facial expressions better be on brand. #ProtestPrep #UnityVibes #TafriTimes (satire)
igHook: What’s your default ‘concerned citizen’ face—stoic or hopeful?
imagePrompt: A large, blurry crowd of people standing in a public square seen from behind, holding small tricolor flags, with a professional camera tripod visible in the foreground.

It manages to feel like a classic, well-oiled satirical piece while avoiding the repetitive 'man forgets permit' or 'man cancels event' tropes seen in other candidates.
